verdict.rationale: dLocal documents outbound notifications to a merchant-registered URL on every payment status change, with signatures to verify integrity. Webhooks can also be triggered in Sandbox. That covers signed delivery, but nothing in the evidence shows the reliability tooling the story asks for. Missing for 10: automatic retry policy, webhook event/delivery logs, manual or programmatic replay, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on signed webhook deliveries with automatic retries, event logs, and replay to keep my system consistent with payment state

citations.quote: Notifications will be sent to the notification URL specified by the merchant for every change in payment status.
By verifying this signature, you'll confirm that the notification was not modified during transmission.
It allows you to safely simulate payments, check API behavior, and trigger webhooks without processing real transactions.
